mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_order WHERE DATE(create_time) = CURDATE()
SELECT IFNULL(SUM(pay_amount), 0) FROM t_order WHERE pay_time IS NOT NULL AND DATE(pay_time) = CURDATE() AND status IN (1, 2, 3, 5, 6)
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_user WHERE DATE(create_time) = CURDATE()
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_order WHERE status = 1

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(pay_time, '%Y-%m-%d') AS date, IFNULL(SUM(pay_amount), 0) AS amount FROM t_order WHERE pay_time IS NOT NULL AND pay_time >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL #{days} - 1 DAY) AND status IN (1, 2, 3, 5, 6) GROUP BY DATE(pay_time) ORDER BY date ASC
SELECT id AS spuId, name, sales_count AS salesCount FROM t_spu ORDER BY sales_count DESC LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT status, COUNT(*) AS count FROM t_order GROUP BY status ORDER BY status ASC
